svg.title: Reading Shelf milestone 2: organize the library
svg.desc: Six-perspective overview. Green marks new subjects: the reader's three new intentions, the collection-name and shared-article rules, two capabilities, the schema migration, the collections and memberships tables, and five new checks. Blue marks changed subjects: the library page, Flask app, SQLite library, page script, Articles API, Library store, Library JSON API and schema version. Gray marks context: the articles table and milestone 1 tests.
svg.text: Reading Shelf milestone 2: organize the library
Proposed change • Collections hold references to one shared article, so notes, status and removals stay consistent.
Upgrades a v1 file to v2
